correctness.rationale: For each fixed even n the multinomial triangular CLT yields the centered normal vector (G_j-Gbar)/sqrt(n) plus kappa n^(-3/4) epsilon_j. The Pearson limit is the corresponding sum of squares, and D/sqrt(N) is a sum of absolute adjacent Gaussian differences. The null Gaussian edge array is one-dependent, with Var(|G_2-G_1|)=2-4/pi and adjacent covariance=1/3+(2sqrt(3)-4)/pi; its long-run variance is sigma^2. The cross moment Cov(|G_2-G_1|,G_1^2-1)=1/sqrt(pi) follows exactly by conditional Gaussian regression and absolute third moments. Even folded-normal mean expansion yields D shift 2kappa^2/sqrt(pi); the random perturbed-edge fluctuation vanishes and Pearson has deterministic shift kappa^2/sqrt(2). The bivariate CLT and inversion of its covariance establish the stated negative optimal Pearson coefficient; normalization and boundary kappa=0 checked. Independent numerical Gaussian cross-moment, folded-normal Taylor, covariance inversion and ratio checks passed.

value.rationale: The recent comb test is expressly motivated by alternating ordered-bin departures. This gives a rigorous Gaussian power comparison in precisely that natural regime, including how dependence with Pearson changes optimal combined screening. The negative Pearson coefficient is a non-obvious dependence effect. No unrestricted Pitman-efficiency or simultaneous sample/bin limit is claimed.

final_claim: For even n, ordered multinomial probabilities (1+kappa n^(1/4)(-1)^j/sqrt(N))/n and N->infinity first then n->infinity even, standardized noncyclic discrete total variation D and Pearson chi-square P converge jointly to a bivariate normal with mean kappa^2(2/(sigma sqrt(pi)),1/sqrt(2)), unit variances and rho=sqrt(2)/(sigma sqrt(pi)), sigma^2=8/3+4(sqrt(3)-3)/pi. The squared Gaussian-shift ratio is 8/(pi sigma^2)=2.420001086..., and among their fixed linear combinations the optimal second weight is negative, proportional to 1-2rho^2.
limitations: Only n even; N->infty first at fixed n; then n->infty. No uniform growing-dimension CLT.
Not conventional Pitman sample efficiency, and best linear combination not an oracle test against the known comb direction.
